True-LD comparison: supplementary table

Chromosome-wide LD difference from the true GWAS LD

Chromosome 22, fixed 250 kb blocks with at least two analysis SNPs. For each block, the mean |difference| over off-diagonal SNP pairs between the true LD (the discovery LD blended at the GWAS composition) and the LD each analysis assumes: PRS-MIX's blend of the reference panels at the same composition, the EUR panel, or the second ancestry's panel. Medians over blocks, and the number of blocks where PRS-MIX is closer to the true LD than the EUR panel. No PRS-CS output and no replicates.
